title: Complete C6c confinement controls and bounded dual-platform execution
goal: Prove all remaining lock, capability and root-confinement controls and run the identical 191-row matrix on Windows and pinned offline Linux within the original short-lock validity window.
acceptanceCriteria: A fail-closed control matrix proves current, missing, altered, stale or expired, wrong-commit and post-production-change behavior for all seven lock families without mutating original evidence.
All 36 external modules reject independent read-root, write-root, process, network and timeout capability broadening, for 180 schema-valid disposable variants.
Root overlap, nested state or evidence, traversal, supported link escape and attempted PackageRoot or TargetRoot writes fail closed while immutable-root fingerprints remain equal.

One orchestrated run starts Windows, pinned network-disabled Linux and control certification concurrently; both platforms prove 191 of 191 rows from identical fixture bytes and have equal normalized semantic projections.

A fresh C6b0 inventory, seven locks, 0.3.0 bundle and synthetic review are bound to the implementation commit; isolated IFX Package regression, Formal Pre and exact committed Formal Diff pass without claiming C6d or C6e.
